operating_notes.text: Current capacity utilization is 65-70% with peak revenue potential of ₹350-400 Cr from existing assets
Planned expansion of ~1200 MT capacity at Anlon site with ₹130 Cr capex (₹70 Cr debt, rest internal)
Revenue contribution guidance: Apiqo ₹120-150 Cr, Anlon ₹180 Cr, Bizotic ₹60 Cr for FY27

timeline.summary: Anlon Healthcare reported Q1FY27 results showing revenue growth to ₹87.56 Cr but PAT decline to ₹8.28 Cr post-acquisition of subsidiaries via share swap.
Anlon Healthcare reported Q1FY27 results showing 163% YoY revenue growth to ₹87.62 Cr and 133% PAT growth to ₹8.28 Cr, driven by consolidation of recent acquisitions.
Anlon Healthcare executed share swap agreements to acquire up to 32.52% in Apiqo Organics and 43.33% in Bizotic Lifescience via preferential allotment.
Anlon Healthcare reported Q1FY27 results showing revenue growth to ₹87.62 Cr and PAT growth to ₹8.28 Cr
Anlon Healthcare Limited’s 13th AGM on September 05, 2026, passed 11 resolutions unanimously via e-voting, including standalone and consolidated financial statements for FY2026.
Anlon Healthcare received a BWR BBB/Stable rating on ₹23.60 Cr of bank loan facilities on September 15, 2026.
Anlon Healthcare shareholders approved the preferential share swap to acquire 44.94% of Apiqo Organics and 47.41% of Bizotic Lifescience at ₹17.85 per share on September 5, 2026.
Anlon Healthcare incorporated ANLON HEALTHCARE NIGERIA LIMITED as a 90%-owned subsidiary on September 20, 2026, to expand into the West African pharma and healthcare market.
Anlon Healthcare approved a ₹250 Cr preferential warrant issue to promoters and public investors on October 13, 2026
